title: Event-Study Grid: Forward Markouts from Tradeable Anchors (with Amendment A10.1)
baseline: phase-6b-approved (master == tag == 295a0e1); event_minute_bars_v2 (45,925,350 rows); D1 = 15,763 events
summary: First forward-return measurement in the program. Scan-free: every quantity derives from event_minute_bars_v2 (0 passes over filtered_trades/filtered_quotes) + frozen 6b tick-anchor artifacts. Markouts are signed log returns from anchors knowable in real time. T1 decomposed realized(09:30). T2 ran the deferred ETH-split decay and the ARBB row-cap detector. T3 built participation baselines + quintiles. T4 constructed clock+rung anchors (ASOF last-trade-at/before); the 09:00 clock anchor tripped escalation row 7 at 11.04% anchor_undefined -> HARD STOP. Cooper approved Amendment A10.1: retain 09:00 with a population guard, raise row 7 to 15%, add flag_possible_row_cap. T5 produced the markout grid; T6 the survivorship census. Amendment A10.2 (Cooper 2026-08-01) added the tradeable detection anchor (+30% crossing) and the contamination test that separates a forward edge from selection arithmetic: A10.2a tripped row 13 (2.50% of D1 never cross 1.30x on tick, D4 basis mismatch) -> A10.3 override (proceed, n=15,369, multiplier stays 1.30); A10.2b (the gate) found the participation gradient does NOT survive at t0_close->t1_close; A10.2c built the detection grid (negative markouts from the tradeable anchor); A10.2d found the rejected-candidate population unrecoverable.

a present baseline session with no premarket bars has a genuine 0 cumulative premarket volume, not undefined; undefined reserved for sessions with no bars (no_baseline)

decisions_log.reason: A10.1c-i (canonical.py), the results/reports/ REPORT copy, docs/Research-Library-Map.md, and A10.2d-iii's docs/Open-Items-Register.md entry all fall outside the sanctioned write dirs (row 9); recorded here and flagged for Cooper at the gate rather than written

surprises: flagship rth_open->t0_close median markout DECLINES monotonically with rising pre-open participation quintile, in BOTH eras, with Q5 negative - the strongest structure in the grid, along participation not entry-timing
ETH-dominant events' median realized fraction never reaches 0.5 on the extended-day clock and actually falls after RTH open, while non-ETH climbs - a clean native split in the extended frame
ARBB lands on EXACTLY 100,000 and EXACTLY 50,000 T=0 prints on two different events; 8 D1 events total sit on {50k,100k,200k} - a near-confirmed collector row cap
the 1,740 no-premarket-print events are a distinct population at RTH open (higher, tighter markout to close) - the population guard was warranted
removing the 8 row-cap and 7 dup events barely moves the flagship median (<0.0002) - aggregate contamination is nil at n=8/7

THE GATE: the participation gradient does NOT survive at t0_close->t1_close (pooled spread 0.008 vs headline 0.25, non-monotonic) - chart 12 matches the selection-arithmetic reading, not a forward-edge reading
the tradeable detection anchor (det+5) markout to t0_close is NEGATIVE in every detection-time bin and both eras (-0.013 to -0.057); latency 0-30min barely matters
runway from +30% detection to the day-high is short: median 30 min / 0.111 log, and ~20% have the high already in at detection
row 13 caught a real D4 disagreement: 2.50% of D1 (incl. NVDA's 10:1 split) show momentum_pct +30..+293% but a tick move < +30% - the events cluster right at the threshold, not scattered
the rejected-candidate (false-positive) population is absent from the archive - every Phase 8 markout is conditional on power-law membership, unmeasurable as a live expected value
